description:
## Finding
\`pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs\`:
- \`MAX_DEPTH: usize = 10\` (private, in build_path body)
- \`DFS_BUDGET: usize = 10_000\` (private constant)

Embedded callers, callers with restricted compute, and callers with adversarially large untrusted pools all have different sweet spots. There is no public API to tune.

## Why P3
- \`pkix-path\` exposes \`max_path_len\` via \`ValidationPolicy\` for its own depth check (defaults to 10) — pkix-path-builder hardcodes the same value separately.
- An embedded caller bringing pkix-path-builder for a small attestation chain may want budget=1_000 and depth=4. They cannot get that today without forking.

## Fix
Add a \`PathBuilderConfig\` (or take \`max_depth: usize, dfs_budget: usize\` parameters on \`build_path\`) and thread through. Default to current values for backwards compatibility.

## Scope reference
\`pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:285,337\`.
title: P3: pkix-path-builder MAX_DEPTH and DFS_BUDGET hardcoded; not callable-tunable
